{{if and .retrieved .container_count}}### Containers Without a Cargo Dispatch Note

The declaration has **{{.container_count}}** containers, but only **{{.cdn_count}}** of them have a Cargo Dispatch Note (CDN) registered with Sri Lanka Customs. The boat note opens once every container has one.

Add **{{.missing_cdn_count}}** more {{if eq (print .missing_cdn_count) "1"}}CDN{{else}}CDNs{{end}} with **Add a Cargo Dispatch Note** on the consignment page. Once Customs has registered {{if eq (print .missing_cdn_count) "1"}}it{{else}}them{{end}}, choose **Check Again**.{{else if .retrieved}}### Container Count Not Available

Sri Lanka Customs returned the declaration without a container count, so the dispatch notes could not be checked against it. Choose **Check Again** to retrieve it again.{{else}}### Could Not Check the Dispatch Notes

The declaration could not be retrieved from Sri Lanka Customs{{if .error}}: {{.error}}{{end}}. Choose **Check Again** to try again.{{end}}
